name: Edgar, Charmed Groom // Edgar Markov's Coffin

faces.name: Edgar, Charmed Groom
faces.text:
Other Vampires you control get +1/+1.
When Edgar dies, return it to the battlefield transformed under its owner's control.

faces.name: Edgar Markov's Coffin
faces.text: At the beginning of your upkeep, create a 1/1 white and black Vampire creature token with lifelink and put a bloodline counter on Edgar Markov's Coffin. Then if there are three or more bloodline counters on it, remove those counters and transform it.
